app_summary: A social network with unidirectional follow relationships, implemented with loosely-coupled microservices, communicating with each other via Thrift RPCs. Supported Operations: Create text post (optional media: image, video, shortened URL, user tag), Read post, Read entire user timeline, Receive recommendations on which users to follow, Search database for user or post, Register/Login using user credentials, Follow/Unfollow user
RCA_gt: No fault is injected. The Social Network workload runs while the AIOpsLab no-op injector performs no mutation, so this is the negative-control scenario.
_source_comment: Ground truth source: AIOpsLab/aiopslab/orchestrator/problems/no_op/no_op.py (Social Network no-op task); AIOpsLab/aiopslab/generators/fault/inject_noop.py (inject and recover methods are no-ops); AIOpsLab/aiopslab/orchestrator/problems/registry.py (problem ID and app_name=social).
